pretreatments.description: Ethanolic organosolv pretreatment with 50% ethanol solution, in the presence of 1% H2SO4, at 120, 140 and 180 °C for 60 min.
Ethanolic organosolv pretreatment with 75% ethanol solution, in the presence of 1% H2SO4, at 120, 140 and 180 °C for 60 min.
Enzymatic hydrolysis using Cellic® CTec2 and Cellic® HTec2 enzyme mixture (1:9 ratio) at 45 ± 1 °C and 120 rpm for 72 h.
Anaerobic digestion of the residual solids and the supernatant.
